title: NA60025: Ocean Engineering Vehicles
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Marine resources Types of ocean structures - fixed and floating. Offshore
exploration vehicles. Different types of drilling and production platforms.
Offshore support vessels; tugs, derrick barges, supply vessels, pipe laying
vessels, salvage vessels, ocean mining vessels, buoys, mooring devices, marine
risers etc. Use of submersibles and ROVs for underwater structures. Underwater
inspection and repairs of structures. Transportation of ocean structures from
building site to the operational field. Materials used for construction.
General tests required for material testing.
